title: TRANSPOSE
author: Robbie
description: Transposes each track by an offset in semitones (-48..+48). Hold TRK + NO: an overlay opens on the selected track. UP / DOWN move the keyboard's range one octave at a time (up to +-4) without changing the transpose. TRIG n sets the transpose to range + (n - 9): TRIG 9 is the range's base, TRIG 1 is 8 semitones below it, TRIG 16 is 7 above. Knob H moves the transpose one semitone per detent, up or down. YES commits (TRK + NO + YES): the transpose is written into the track's note-locks and reset to 0. Only the step's main note moves; the pattern is changed only by COMMIT. Stock tracks only. Needs core 4.1 and seq-events 0.2.
